reply: Thank you so much! We're glad you think {app_name} is the best way to learn new languages. Enjoy your lessons!
Obrigado pela avaliação. Entendemos que ter que pagar para ter mais energia deixa a experiência pior, e compartilhamos seu comentário com a equipe.

Thank you for raising both points: the many learners asking for a Persian course, and the impact of the English Test restriction on Iranian users. We understand why this is so disappointing. Your feedback has been shared, and questions about test access can be sent to {support_contact}.

Sentimos muito que o áudio das aulas de francês pare no meio da lição, isso impede de ouvir os personagens. Por favor, envie o modelo do seu aparelho e a versão do app para {support_contact}, para que a equipe possa investigar.
Thanks for letting us know the chess piece movements feel less smooth than in earlier versions. Please send your device and app version to {support_contact} so the team can look into it.
Thanks for the review, and we're glad everything else is good! Running out of energy right before a hard exercise is frustrating, and we've shared your request with the team.
¡Muchas gracias! Nos alegra saber que estás aprendiendo mucho. ¡Sigue practicando!
Que ótimo! Ficamos felizes que você já aprendeu várias palavras em pouco tempo, como snake = cobra. Continue assim!
Lamentamos que no puedas hacer una racha con tus amigos. Escríbenos a {support_contact} con tu dispositivo y la versión de la app para que el equipo revise qué está pasando.
Obrigado pela avaliação. Sentimos que as histórias e os diálogos não estejam ajudando você a aprender o idioma como esperava. Compartilhamos seu comentário com a equipe.
Thank you! We love hearing that {app_name} is helping you learn so much. Keep it up!

Thanks for the update. Sorry your evening practice reminders have stopped arriving while other notifications still come through. Please contact {support_contact} with your device and app version so the team can look into it.

Sorry about that ad. Being stuck on a screen for minutes without a way to continue is really frustrating between lessons, and we've shared your feedback about ads that require playing a mini game with the team.
Obrigado pelo comentário! Entendemos que a nova cara da corujinha não agradou, e vamos compartilhar seu pedido com a equipe.

Lamentamos que la app no guarde tus lecciones y que se use un protector de racha aunque hayas practicado. Escríbenos a {support_contact} con tu dispositivo, la versión de la app y las fechas en que ocurrió para que el equipo lo revise.
Thank you for sharing your view on the use of AI. We've passed your feedback on to the team.
Schön, dass du gut lernst! Wir verstehen, dass die Kosten für Energie und Abos zu hoch wirken und dass ein kostenloser Test ohne Abo gerade für Kinder einfacher wäre. Dein Feedback geht an das Team.
Pedimos desculpas se as mensagens da corujinha passaram do tom. Se algo realmente preocupante aconteceu no app, entre em contato com {support_contact}.
Thanks for the review. Sorry the hints and reminders sometimes show up when you don't want them, and your feedback has been shared with the team.
詳しいご指摘ありがとうございます。英語と同じような単語の繰り返しが多いこと、訳に韓国語が表示されること、arrivederciやvociの「ci」の音が抜けることは、端末とアプリのバージョンを添えて{support_contact}までお知らせください。チームで確認いたします。

Danke für dein ausführliches Feedback. Werbung nach jeder Lektion nervt, und für Kinder ungeeignete Anzeigen sind nicht in Ordnung. Deine Kritik an der Batterie und an Nachrichten wie „Liebst du mich noch?“ geht an das Team. Unpassende Werbung kannst du an {support_contact} melden.
Thanks for telling us. We understand many learners preferred hearts to the new energy system, and your feedback has been shared with the team.
丁寧なレビューありがとうございます！英語と数学を楽しく続けられていると聞いて、とても嬉しいです。最初の画面が少し苦手とのご意見はチームに共有しますね。これからも自分のペースで頑張ってください！
Sorry the Super {app_name} promotions are getting in the way. If you've lost progress, please contact {support_contact} with your device and app version so the team can check what happened.

We hear how upsetting this restriction on the {app_name} English Test is for you and for the people affected. Your feedback has been shared, and questions about test access can be sent to {support_contact}.
Sorry the upgrade prompts feel nonstop. We understand they interrupt your learning, and we've shared your feedback with the team.
¡Gracias por tu reseña! Nos alegra que las palabras y las lecciones te parezcan interesantes. ¡Sigue aprendiendo!

Thank you for your feedback. We understand how unfair this restriction feels to the students affected by it, and your message has been shared. Questions about access to the {app_name} English Test can be sent to {support_contact}.
Vielen Dank! Schön, dass dir die Übungen so logisch vorkommen und dich motivieren, weiterzumachen. Viel Spaß beim Lernen!

Sorry {app_name} hasn't worked for you. If you see ads that look like scams, please report them to {support_contact} so they can be reviewed. Your feedback about the example sentences has been shared with the team.
Entendemos a frustração quando o recorde de 100 no piano não vem! Continue praticando, e se o jogo parecer não funcionar direito, conte para a gente em {support_contact}.
Tranquilo, {app_name} no tiene nada que ver con la desaparición de tu perro. ¡Esperamos que aparezca pronto y que sigas practicando con nosotros!

Thanks for the review, and great to hear your Spanish is coming along well! It's disappointing that the game section is gone, even for languages you'd already played, and we've shared that with the team.

We're sorry your progress keeps being undone overnight, especially after a month of repeating the same subsection and paying for Timer Boosts. Please contact {support_contact} with your device, app version and account email so the team can investigate.
Lamentamos que la energía se acabe a mitad de la lección y tengas que repetirla. Entendemos que preferías los corazones, y compartimos tu opinión con el equipo.

Thanks for the honest review! We're glad you're learning some Portuguese, and we understand daily reminders and losing hearts can feel like too much pressure. Your feedback has been shared with the team.
Danke für deine Bewertung! Schade, dass dir das neue App-Icon so gar nicht gefällt und sich die App eher wie ein Spiel anfühlt. Wir geben dein Feedback an das Team weiter.

We're sorry the change from hearts to battery made you stop learning with {app_name}. Getting through only one perfect lesson before running out is frustrating, and your feedback has been shared with the team.
Thank you! We're happy {app_name} makes learning feel easy and enjoyable. Keep it up!
Thank you for the recommendation! We're glad you love learning with {app_name}.
Lamentamos que la energía no te alcance ni para una lección y que sientas que la app te obliga a pagar. Entendemos la frustración, y compartimos tu opinión con el equipo.
